info.title: NetForms project converter
info.description: Moves a Windows Forms project to NetForms so it builds and runs on Linux: reports what carries over, then rewrites the .csproj (UseWindowsForms to the NetForms package, net8.0-windows to net10.0).

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Converts a Windows Forms project to NetForms (Windows and Linux).
